headline: UK Watchdog Finds Viagogo May Have Used Unlawful Hidden Fees
summary: The UK Competition and Markets Authority provisionally found that ticket-reselling website Viagogo may have breached law by utilizing drip pricing tactics.
why: The Competition and Markets Authority is the principal market regulator enforcing competition and consumer rights in the United Kingdom.

impacts.name: Viagogo
impacts.why: The CMA issued provisional findings that the company engaged in non-compliant drip pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
